'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Unknown player DS Kessel (page 39)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by an unknown player (no name on the sheet) at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

The player name, deck name, date and both side boxes are blank on this sheet; the side is Dark by its cards. The sheet lists 60 main-deck lines and 12 shields.

'''Transcription notes''' (left for later cleanup): Line 2 written ''—: Spice Mines Adm. Office'': ditto mark for Kessel; Kessel: Spice Mines Administration Office? not confirmed; Line 6 written ''EPP Maul'': not expanded; Line 7 written ''"'': ditto of EPP Maul; Line 8 written ''Kessel: Spice Mine Passages'': not confirmed; Line 9 written ''Kessel Surveillance System'': not confirmed; Line 10 written ''MM & EO'': not expanded; Line 11 written ''KDY'': abbreviation, (V) box ticked; Line 14 written ''GA Thrawn'': not expanded; Line 15 written ''Adm Ozzel'': not expanded; Line 16 written ''Close Call'' (V): reading not confirmed; Line 17 written ''"'' (V): ditto of line 16; Line 18 written ''"'' (V): ditto of line 16; Line 19 written ''B1'' (V): not identified; Line 20 written ''Victory'': one word; not confirmed; Line 21 written ''"'': ditto of Victory; Line 25 written ''Spice Mines of Kessel'' (V): not confirmed; Line 26 written ''Overlook'': not identified; Line 27 written ''Spice Mine Ops'': not expanded; Line 28 written ''Kessel Spice Mine Entr...'': not confirmed; Line 30 written ''Spice Mines Admin'': not expanded; Line 31 written ''"'': ditto of line 30; Line 32 written ''Gen Veers'' (V): not expanded; Line 33 written ''Black Sun Ship'': not identified; Line 35 written ''Op As Planned'' (V): not expanded; Line 36 written ''Grollo Wrecker'' (V): not identified; Line 37 written ''EPP Vader'': not expanded; Line 38 written ''C & SFS'': not expanded; Line 39 written ''EPP Mara'': not expanded; Line 40 written ''He Is Not Ready combo'': not expanded; Line 42 written ''The Emperor's Royals'': not identified; Line 45 written ''Blizzard 6'' (V): number not confirmed; Line 46 written ''I'll Take Them Myself'' (V): only a non-(V) page was found for I'll Take Them Myself; no Dark Side wiki page found for I'll Take Them Myself (V); Line 48 written ''Sniper & DS'': not expanded; Line 51 written ''SSPF Chimaera'' (V): not confirmed; Line 54 written ''(blank)'': line left blank on the sheet; Line 58 written ''EPP G-Lance'' (V): not identified; Shield 8 written ''Secret Plans'' (V): only a non-(V) page was found for Secret Plans; no Dark Side wiki page found for Secret Plans (V). Lines in italics are as written on the sheet and are not linked because the card or its version could not be identified for certain.
